# scripts/mutation-pr.sh chooses the default whole-run limit: 3600 when the diff changes a Go file under internal/flow, otherwise 1200.
# Only gremlins, timeout and getconf are stubs. The stub timeout writes its limit to limit.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:git] skip
env HOME=$WORK/home
env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
env GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
chmod 755 fake/gremlins
chmod 755 fake/timeout
chmod 755 fake/getconf
env PATH=$WORK/fake:$PATH
env FAKE_CORES=16

exec git init -q -b main repo
mkdir repo/internal/flow
cp a.go repo/a.go
cp f.go repo/internal/flow/f.go
cp gomod repo/go.mod
script mutation-pr.sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh
exec git -C repo add a.go internal go.mod scripts
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base

# A change outside internal/flow keeps the limit of 1200.
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b outside
cp a2.go repo/a.go
exec git -C repo add a.go
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m outside
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/outside.json
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^1200$' limit

# A change under internal/flow gets 3600.
exec git -C repo checkout -q main
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b flow
cp f2.go repo/internal/flow/f.go
exec git -C repo add internal
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m flow
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/flow.json
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^3600$' limit

# An empty MUTATION_TIMEOUT takes the default, and a set one wins over it.
env MUTATION_TIMEOUT=
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^3600$' limit
env MUTATION_TIMEOUT=50
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^50$' limit

-- gomod --
module example.com/r

go 1.27
-- a.go --
package a
-- a2.go --
package a

func F(x int) bool { return x > 0 }
-- f.go --
package flow
-- f2.go --
package flow

func F(x int) bool { return x > 0 }
-- fake/gremlins --
#!/bin/sh
cp "$GREMLINS_REPORT" "$5"
-- fake/timeout --
#!/bin/sh
echo "$3" > "$WORK/limit"
shift 3
exec "$@"
-- fake/getconf --
#!/bin/sh
echo "$FAKE_CORES"
-- outside.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
-- flow.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"internal/flow/f.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
